shots.name: actions
shots.description: Teleport, Blick, native Tasten, Maus und eval mit Zustandsprüfung.

actions.code: (() => { const p = window.__bodycam.player; if (p.position[0] !== 1 || p.position[1] !== 2 || p.position[2] >= 3 || p.yawDeg !== 25 || p.pitchDeg !== -8 || !p.keys.includes('down:KeyW') || !p.keys.includes('up:KeyW') || !p.keys.includes('up:ShiftLeft') || p.clicks < 2 || !p.started) throw new Error('Action state mismatch'); return {verified:true}; })()
